steps.content: You desperately release your power, but the monsters form a vast and never-ending ocean, the path you cut open is instantly flooded.
You're even a bit dazed. All these faces... didn't you just see them a few seconds ago? Didn't you just cut them down? How long have you been fighting? How many enemies are you fighting?
And before you know it, that behemoth armor has disappeared from your sight, even its last roar sounds far away.

steps.speaker: Monster
steps.content: Roarrrr!
You blast open a gap again, but lack the strength to run. Another wave of monsters is approaching, you desperately raise your hand, but your vision gradually blurs...
Just then, you hear a voice.
Don't move, save your strength.
I'll handle the rest.
The voice is calm, completely out of place in this madness, but it's surprisingly persuasive. Your body follows the instruction on its own.
You get down instantly. At the same time, a loud thud comes from behind you with a gust rushing over your head. The violent and fierce attack collides with a sturdy metal armor.
A woman clad in heavy mechanical armor leaps in front of you, the ground and your eardrums vibrating as she lands. The next moment, she swings a powerful punch with her other arm.
Boom—

The extraordinary punch, with a terrifying sonic boom and wind pressure, blasts several monsters over a dozen meters away into a wall of rock like cannonballs. Bits of rock and earth collapse, burying the monsters.
The woman does not linger in the fight. She picks you up—her mechanical arm hoists you on one side. As you get closer, she lowers her voice, just loud enough for you to hear clearly.
Cover your head!

As you shield your head with both hands, your body is pulled forward suddenly. You feel like you're being carried by a raging rhino charging into a dense forest. You see her other mechanical arm swiping back and forth, sending monsters flying like fallen leaves.

All you can hear are the silent screams, the sound of mechanical parts hitting the ground, and the thick wind. With your feet off the ground, you're rendered speechless by the jolts. Yet she presses on without slowing down, and then makes a big jump. After a dozen seconds later, your feet finally touch the ground again.
You realize that the person carrying you is not some mighty gorilla, but a woman of ordinary stature, who's equipped with two large and robust mechanical arms.

Don't fight them in the eye of the storm. Time is a tangled mess in there. When you're up against a monster, you're facing its present, past, and future selves all at once. Each and every version of it is an independent entity. You can't possibly finish them off.
But eventually all these versions of them will converge into one, so you only need to take one down, and wait for the others to die on their own.
That won't do if you're in a hurry though.
You stare at her unfamiliar yet reassuring face for a while, trying hard to memorize it, then you say...

options: I'm not in a hurry anymore.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've found you.
The woman nods, looking towards somewhere you can't see.
Those monsters will reappear in no time. Let's leave now. The camp is not far away. I'll carry you; it's faster that way.
This time it'll be less bumpy.
She carries you in a more comfy way with her mechanical arm, then strides forward.
Oh right, you don't know her name yet, but your anxiety has long since disappeared. It's like you're finally standing on solid ground. You feel like you can follow her anywhere.
